description: Calculate proton CSDA range, stopping power, Bragg peak, distal R80 and relative dose per fluence in water or ICRU soft tissue. Uses Bethe range and Bortfeld (1997) with Gaussian straggling and initial energy spread; tissue is water-equivalent and energies above 200 MeV are extrapolated.

spread_percent.description: Gaussian energy standard deviation in percent, 0–5; default 1.

name: bragg_peak
title: Proton Bragg peak and range
